grimoire.herbalwitch.guide.acquisition.0: Break grass and ferns by hand to forage. Starter herbs turn up anywhere, other herbs only in their own habitats; each herb page says where and how often.
grimoire.herbalwitch.guide.acquisition.1: Wild patches grow in their habitats as well. Plant seeds on farmland or a herb bed; a mature plant gives two fresh herbs and a seed when you use it.
grimoire.herbalwitch.guide.acquisition.2: Carrying any form of a herb (seeds, fresh, dried or powdered) records it here.
grimoire.herbalwitch.guide.getting_start: This grimoire records what you have learned. Any grimoire opens your own knowledge, so giving one away or crafting with it shares or loses nothing.
Guides like this one are open to everyone. Herb and recipe pages fill in as you discover them, and nothing here stops you crafting, brewing or automating anything.
Begin with a starter herb: lavender, sage, mint and chamomile turn up when you break tall grass anywhere.
grimoire.herbalwitch.guide.heat.0: The kettle and the infusion pot need heat from directly below: a lit hearth or stove, a lit campfire or magma. One hopper may stand between them and carry the heat.
grimoire.herbalwitch.guide.heat.1: The hearth and the stove burn ordinary fuel. A waterlogged vessel gets no heat.
grimoire.herbalwitch.guide.heat.title: Heat
grimoire.herbalwitch.guide.missing_ingre: Opened from a grimoire, a stand or a bookshelf, a recipe page counts what you carry against what it needs.
Only your main inventory and offhand count: not armour, containers you carry, nearby storage or a station's own slots. Nothing is ever taken.
A station slot holds one kind of item, so different alternatives are not added together. Returned bottles and bowls are results, not ingredients.
Ingredients available means the items are there; it does not check the station's slots, its heat or room for the result.
grimoire.herbalwitch.guide.preparation.0: Fresh herbs dry on a drying rack into bundles. A mortar grinds bundles into powder. Powders steep with a water bottle in a kettle, or go into an infusion pot with a base and a container.
grimoire.herbalwitch.guide.preparation.1: Each recipe page lists exactly what its station needs, how long it takes and whether it needs heat, and links to the recipes that make its ingredients.
grimoire.herbalwitch.guide.preparation.2: When every ingredient of a recipe is familiar to you, the recipe records itself.
grimoire.herbalwitch.guide.products.0: Teas, remedies, tonics, the salve, oils and garden products each do one thing today, written on their recipe page and their tooltip.
grimoire.herbalwitch.guide.products.1: Witch energy is not part of this version. When witchcraft arrives, some preparations will matter for it too; what you make now keeps working as it does.
grimoire.herbalwitch.guide.research.0: At a grimoire stand or a witch's bookshelf you may research a recipe when at least one of its ingredients is familiar: you carry it, or it is a form of a herb you know.
grimoire.herbalwitch.guide.research.1: Research is instant and free, and records the recipe only; it gives no items.
grimoire.herbalwitch.guide.research.2: The stand opens on the recipes you could research right now.
grimoire.herbalwitch.guide.stations.0: A station keeps its ingredients in its own slots, reserved while it works, and fills its output when it is done. Closing its screen leaves it working.
grimoire.herbalwitch.guide.stations.1: The Grimoire button on a station's screen opens this book beside it, on that station's recipes.
grimoire.herbalwitch.guide.teaching.0: At a stand or bookshelf, open a recipe you know and offer it to a player within eight blocks.
grimoire.herbalwitch.guide.teaching.1: They are told who offers what, and may accept or decline from their own grimoire within thirty seconds. Accepting records that one recipe and nothing else.
grimoire.herbalwitch.guide.teaching.2: An offer ends when either of you leaves, dies or changes dimension, or when the teacher closes their book.
